flask_restx: flask-restx: the package route decorators are imported from
route: flask-restx: Namespace.route / Api.route, the class decorator naming a resource's path
Namespace: flask-restx: the constructor for a mountable group of resources
add_namespace: flask-restx: the Api method that mounts a namespace
path: flask-restx: the path keyword on Namespace(...) and add_namespace(...)
prefix: flask-restx: the prefix keyword on Api(...), served in front of every namespace path
init_app: flask-restx: the Api method that takes the app or blueprint after the Api was built
flask: flask: the package Blueprint is imported from
Blueprint: flask: the constructor for a group of routes registered under one url_prefix
url_prefix: flask: the prefix keyword on Blueprint(...) and register_blueprint(...)
register_blueprint: flask: the method that registers a blueprint on an app or on another blueprint
decoratedClassRoute: suss: PythonDiscoveryPattern variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python
flaskConverters: suss: path-template syntax name, defined in @suss/adapter-python; selects the <name> / <converter:name> reader for Flask-style paths
replaces: suss: MountPrefixEffect value, defined in @suss/adapter-python; says a mount-call prefix swaps out the constructor's rather than going in front of it
trimmed: suss: PrefixTrailingSlash value, defined in @suss/adapter-python; says the library drops trailing slashes off a namespace path before a route path joins it
unstated: suss: NoValuePrefix value, defined in @suss/adapter-python; says the library reads a path written as an empty string, None, False or zero the way it reads no path at all
merged: suss: PathRepeatedSlashes value, defined in @suss/adapter-python; says the library answers a path carrying repeated slashes at the merged one
Flask: flask: the app constructor, whose before_request hooks and error handlers reach every route
Api: flask-restx: the constructor the namespaces are mounted on; its error handlers reach every route
before_request: flask: the app decorator that registers a hook run before every request; a value it returns is the response
errorhandler: flask and flask-restx: the decorator on the app, the Api or a Namespace that registers a function run when a view raises
decoratedWrapper: suss: PyWrapperForm variant tag, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a function registered through a decorator attribute on the app
everyRoute: suss: PyWrapperRegistrar coverage, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a registration on the app or the Api reaches every route of the pack
ownRoutes: suss: PyWrapperRegistrar coverage, defined in @suss/adapter-python; a registration on a Namespace reaches the resources routed on it
